archetypes.name: dyn-gh-wrapper-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Boundary degradation must stay identical after the wrapper swap.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect skills/voter-calibration/scripts/voter-calibration.py _resolve_era_boundary_auto. Confirm gh.issue_view_field_read(proc, ...) preserves unavailable handling for missing gh, nonzero results, empty or malformed JSON, non-object payloads, and closedAt_unavailable, and that repo_unresolved still skips GitHub. Check the deleted _run_gh_json path is gone and no new uncaught exceptions appear on degraded CommandResult. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
